description: Nonsecret inventory of every notebook inference, safety, and mock call site routed through shared.budget.guarded_request. Labels match the label= argument at each call site. estimated_input_tokens uses shared.budget.estimate_prompt_tokens on the largest fixed prompt for the site; reserved_tokens = max_attempts * (estimated_input_tokens + max_output_tokens) for model and safety kinds and 0 for mock. Management-plane (ARM) calls are not budgeted.

call_sites.label: demo1.gateway_warmup
call_sites.note: Unscored warm-up until the new API, subscription, and policy are live (APIM propagates asynchronously on a fresh instance); uses its own x-demo-run counter.

call_sites.label: demo1.daily_call
call_sites.note: Bounded loop of 60 iterations and 180 seconds; after a 429 it waits for Retry-After and the next iteration is a new counted attempt.

call_sites.label: demo2.gateway_warmup
call_sites.note: Unscored warm-up until the new API, subscription, and policy are live; a successful warm-up's usage is reconciled with the emitted metrics.

call_sites.label: demo2.transport_retry
call_sites.note: One retry after a call that got no response, usually a stalled TLS handshake that sent nothing.

call_sites.label: demo2.optional_stream_call
call_sites.note: Commented out in the notebook; enabling it requires a revised envelope.

call_sites.label: demo3.gateway_warmup
call_sites.note: Unscored warm-up until the new API, subscription, and policy are live.

call_sites.label: demo3.transport_retry
call_sites.note: One retry after a call that got no response, usually a stalled TLS handshake that sent nothing.

call_sites.label: demo3.stream_retry
call_sites.note: One more observation after a transport or protocol error that carried no content-safety evidence.

call_sites.label: demo4.routing_warmup
call_sites.note: Up to 10 unscored warm-up calls per switch to routing mode (2 switches), until 3 consecutive mock responses; budgeted as model calls because a stale route can still reach real inference.

call_sites.label: demo4.routing_call
call_sites.note: CALL 1, CALL 2, 30 weighted, 12 East-fault, 6 Central, 12 both-fault, and 12 recovery calls to the APIM-hosted mock origin.

call_sites.label: demo4.routing_retry
call_sites.note: One retry after a 30-second timeout on a routing call; the gateway occasionally stalls a mock call.

call_sites.label: demo4.switch_probe
call_sites.note: Up to 12 direct probes per mock fault or heal switch (6 switches) until the named-value change is live; never routed through the pool.
